svg.title: Countries of Europe - 1914 - with labels
svg.desc: Labeled and coloured Map of Europe as it was in mid-1914, prior to the outbreak of World War 1. Every country has an ID which is its ISO3166-1-Alpha-3 code in lower case. Based on Alphathon's https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Blank_map_of_Europe_1914.svg and Niusereset's https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Europe_1914_(coloured).png
